description: Correct an existing ledger transaction when the user wants to fix a mistake — a wrong amount, date, category, payee, who paid, or which heir/asset it relates to. Find the transaction's ID with get_transactions first. This is a PARTIAL update: pass transaction_id plus ONLY the fields that change; everything you omit is left as-is. Use this (not a new correcting entry) whenever the user says an amount or detail was wrong. Confirm the correction with the user before calling.

category.description: Change the category. Must belong to the transaction's direction (same taxonomy as log_transaction).

direction.description: Change the direction. If you change this, also pass a matching category.

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.

heir_id.description: Change the related heir ID (for distributions).

paid_by.description: Change who paid (disbursements). 'individual' means a person paid out of pocket and is owed reimbursement.

payee_or_source.description: Change who was paid (money out) or the source (money in).

payer_name.description: When paid_by='individual' AND someone other than the user paid, the person's name. Omit if the user themselves paid.

transaction_id.description: ID of the transaction to update (from get_transactions).

name: update_transaction
